browserRuns.cooldownNote: The cooldown was conservatively restarted from zero after the last timer output before context compaction was not retained as verifiable evidence.

cooldownRule: Each numbered run was followed by at least 300 seconds of idle time before another benchmark, test, or repository operation. Each cooldown was recorded as six completed 50-second waits. The S-1K to S-10K cooldown was restarted from zero because one earlier wait output was lost at context compaction; only the fully repeated 300 seconds is credited. The final S-100K run was followed by the same six-wait cooldown.

excludedRuns.reason: These four results expose the first S3 implementation's O(total-ledger) save regression. Their start timestamps were not persisted, so they are retained as raw diagnostic evidence and are not presented as the final numbered measurement series.

interpretation: S3 stores independently encrypted count-based fact chunks with no inter-chunk hash chain. The ordinary append path rewrites only the open chunk plus a header, while retaining complete readback and exact byte verification. The final data are compared only against the committed S2 baseline; the excluded initial S3 results remain separately attributable regression evidence.
